name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Pension scheme targeted towards citizens in the unorganized sector for guaranteed monthly pension.
benefits: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60
documents_required: Active Savings Bank Account with auto-debit facility

criteria.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old
criteria.disqualification_reason: Minimum entry age for APY is 18

criteria.description: Applicant must be under 40 years old
criteria.disqualification_reason: Maximum entry age for APY is 40

criteria.description: Must possess a savings bank account
criteria.disqualification_reason: Active bank account required for contribution auto-debit
